<description>
Depends supports building packages from a local directory by creating an archive in `SOURCES_PATH`.

The archive filename was derived only from the relative local directory path. As a result, different worktrees using a shared `SOURCES_PATH` could refer to the same archive. If the archive created by one worktree was newer than all paths in another, the second worktree would reuse source contents from the first.

Include a shortened hash of the absolute local source path in the archive filename. This gives different worktrees separate archives and fetched stamps while retaining the existing mtime-based invalidation.

This approach is as suggested by ryanofsky in #35764. It therefore does not change the general mtime-based invalidation model.

Addresses #35764
</description>
